title: Lunch in the Vineyard: A Scenic Niagara Wine Tour Experience
includes: A gourmet cheese sample plate at one of the winery stops
Shareable artisan woodfire pizza and large salad for lunch
Stops at 4 of Niagara’s finest wineries (12-16 total wine tastings)
An expert guide who's fun, friendly, and knowledgeable
Pick up and drop off at a single location within Niagara Falls or Niagara-on-the-Lake
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A Wine Tour in Niagara doesn't have to take ALL day. Enjoy all of the indulgent tastings and high-quality experiences WITHOUT sitting on a bus for hours with our incredible Lunch Tour.

We've "trimmed the fat" on this tour so your time is spent touring wineries and enjoying tastings - not driving back and forth between destinations. In just 5 short hours, you'll enjoy stops at 4 wineries, a gourmet cheese sample plate at one of the winery stops, a delicious artisan woodfire pizza for lunch, and more.
